properties.name: icon
properties.comment: The icon at one or more sizes, premultiplied BGRA8 (HostImage). Throws std::invalid_argument for more than 8 images or an image that is malformed or larger than 256 pixels a side. A write updates a shown icon, even when unchanged. UI thread only (std::logic_error).
hand: a view onto images_: every write synchronizes the host icon and records its status

properties.name: text
properties.comment: The tooltip, at most 127 bytes of UTF-8 (std::invalid_argument otherwise). A changed write updates a shown icon. UI thread only (std::logic_error).
hand: shared TextCapability<NotifyIcon> (study 15.3): prepare_write checks the thread, UTF-8 and host length; written synchronizes the host icon; nothing invalidated

properties.name: visible
properties.comment: Whether the application wants the icon shown. Every write shows or removes the icon, even when unchanged, and status() then holds the host's answer: unsupported without a host or without the notification_area capability, invalid_argument while there is no icon image. A visible icon without an image is shown once an image is set. UI thread only (std::logic_error).
hand: a view onto visible_: every write synchronizes, so a repeated true re-adds an icon a host session dropped

properties.name: context_menu
properties.comment: The menu shown on the icon's context gesture. Hosts with native tray menus (notification_area_menus) show its rows natively; choosing a row executes its command and raises menu_item_invoked. Submenus are left out. Without native tray menus only click is raised. UI thread only (std::logic_error).

not_properties.name: status
not_properties.reason: the host's answer to the last request; read-only

not_properties.name: show_balloon_tip
not_properties.reason: a request with several arguments; a method
